## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> Return the link to the WriteStack features board, where the user can post a product or feature idea for others to vote on. This tool only returns the link: it does not submit, store, or send the idea anywhere, and you cannot submit suggestions on the user's behalf. Use when the user asks for functionality that is not currently possible in the MCP or app, then tell them to post their idea at https://writestack.io/features.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | `string` | No | Optional extra context about why this is needed |
| `suggestion` | `string` | Yes | Short summary of the feature the user wants. It is not submitted anywhere; the user posts it on the features board themselves. Min length 5. |
